------------------------------ MODULE W4Od4m1p4t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Stations, Lines, Bays, MaxWait

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES tokenAt, stage, held, waiting, pool
vars == <<tokenAt, stage, held, waiting, pool>>

RingNext(s) == (s % Stations) + 1
LineOf(s) == IF s % 2 = 1 THEN "L1" ELSE "L2"

Occupied == {s \in 1 .. Stations : stage[s] # "free"}
UsedBays == {held[s] : s \in Occupied}

Init ==
    /\ tokenAt = 1
    /\ stage = [s \in 1 .. Stations |-> "free"]
    /\ held = [s \in 1 .. Stations |-> NONE]
    /\ waiting = [l \in Lines |-> 0]
    /\ pool = Bays

Arrive(l) ==
    /\ waiting[l] < MaxWait
    /\ waiting' = [waiting EXCEPT ![l] = waiting[l] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, stage, held, pool>>

PassToken(s) ==
    /\ tokenAt = s
    /\ tokenAt' = RingNext(s)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stage, held, waiting, pool>>

Admit(s) ==
    /\ tokenAt = s
    /\ stage[s] = "free"
    /\ waiting[LineOf(s)] > 0
    /\ pool # {}
    /\ \E b \in pool :
        /\ pool' = pool \ {b}
        /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![s] = b]
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![s] = "washing"]
    /\ waiting' = [waiting EXCEPT ![LineOf(s)] = waiting[LineOf(s)] - 1]
    /\ tokenAt' = RingNext(s)

Advance(s) ==
    /\ stage[s] = "washing"
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![s] = "rinsing"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, held, waiting, pool>>

Finish(s) ==
    /\ stage[s] = "rinsing"
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {held[s]}
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, waiting>>

Next ==
    \/ \E l \in Lines : Arrive(l)
    \/ \E s \in 1 .. Stations : PassToken(s)
    \/ \E s \in 1 .. Stations : Admit(s)
    \/ \E s \in 1 .. Stations : Advance(s)
    \/ \E s \in 1 .. Stations : Finish(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityInvariant ==
    /\ Cardinality(UsedBays) <= Cardinality(Bays)
    /\ pool \cap UsedBays = {}
    /\ pool \cup UsedBays = Bays
    /\ \A s, t \in Occupied : (s # t) => held[s] # held[t]

================================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Stations = 4
    Lines = {"L1", "L2"}
    Bays = {b1, b2}
    MaxWait = 2
INVARIANT CapacityInvariant

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od2m9p5t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Tasks, Ctrls, MaxEpoch

NONE == "none"
Unclaimed == [ctrl |-> NONE, ep |-> 0]

VARIABLES pool, claim, delivered, epoch
vars == <<pool, claim, delivered, epoch>>

Claimed == {t \in Tasks : claim[t].ctrl # NONE}

Init ==
    /\ pool = Tasks
    /\ claim = [t \in Tasks |-> Unclaimed]
    /\ delivered = {}
    /\ epoch = 0

Claim(c, t) ==
    /\ t \in pool
    /\ pool' = pool \ {t}
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![t] = [ctrl |-> c, ep |-> epoch]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<delivered, epoch>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, claim, delivered>>

SweepStale(t) ==
    /\ claim[t].ctrl # NONE
    /\ claim[t].ep < epoch
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {t}
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![t] = Unclaimed]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<delivered, epoch>>

Deliver(t) ==
    /\ claim[t].ctrl # NONE
    /\ claim[t].ep = epoch
    /\ t \notin delivered
    /\ delivered' = delivered \cup {t}
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![t] = Unclaimed]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, epoch>>

Idle ==
    /\ delivered = Tasks
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls, t \in Tasks : Claim(c, t)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E t \in Tasks : SweepStale(t)
    \/ \E t \in Tasks : Deliver(t)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Partition ==
    /\ pool \cap Claimed = {}
    /\ pool \cap delivered = {}
    /\ Claimed \cap delivered = {}
    /\ pool \cup Claimed \cup delivered = Tasks

================================================================================

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od5m4p3t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, Slots, MaxPool

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES pool, slotOf, playerSlot
vars == <<pool, slotOf, playerSlot>>

Seated(p) == playerSlot[p] # NONE

Init ==
    /\ pool = {}
    /\ slotOf = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ playerSlot = [p \in Players |-> NONE]

Request(p) ==
    /\ p \notin pool
    /\ ~Seated(p)
    /\ Cardinality(pool) < MaxPool
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOf, playerSlot>>

Assign(p, s) ==
    /\ p \in pool
    /\ slotOf[s] = NONE
    /\ pool' = pool \ {p}
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ playerSlot' = [playerSlot EXCEPT ![p] = s]

Release(s) ==
    /\ slotOf[s] # NONE
    /\ playerSlot' = [playerSlot EXCEPT ![slotOf[s]] = NONE]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED pool

Abandon(p) ==
    /\ p \in pool
    /\ pool' = pool \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOf, playerSlot>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Request(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots : Assign(p, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Abandon(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualInverse ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : slotOf[s] # NONE => playerSlot[slotOf[s]] = s
    /\ \A p \in Players : playerSlot[p] # NONE => slotOf[playerSlot[p]] = p

================================================================================

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od16m7p4t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Stations, Drugs, Stock, MaxQueue

NONE == "free"

VARIABLES reg, remaining, dispensed, phase, queue
vars == <<reg, remaining, dispensed, phase, queue>>

Init ==
    /\ reg = NONE
    /\ remaining = [d \in Drugs |-> Stock]
    /\ dispensed = [d \in Drugs |-> 0]
    /\ phase = [w \in Stations |-> "idle"]
    /\ queue = << >>

Prescribe(d) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < MaxQueue
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, d)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, remaining, dispensed, phase>>

Acquire(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "idle"
    /\ reg = NONE
    /\ reg' = w
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "holding"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<remaining, dispensed, queue>>

Dispense(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "holding"
    /\ reg = w
    /\ queue # << >>
    /\ LET d == Head(queue) IN
        /\ remaining[d] > 0
        /\ remaining' = [remaining EXCEPT ![d] = remaining[d] - 1]
        /\ dispensed' = [dispensed EXCEPT ![d] = dispensed[d] + 1]
        /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, phase>>

Release(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "holding"
    /\ reg = w
    /\ reg' = NONE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<remaining, dispensed, queue>>

StaleSwap(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "idle"
    /\ reg # NONE
    /\ reg # w
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

DropHead ==
    /\ queue # << >>
    /\ remaining[Head(queue)] = 0
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, remaining, dispensed, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drugs : Prescribe(d)
    \/ DropHead
    \/ \E w \in Stations : Acquire(w)
    \/ \E w \in Stations : Dispense(w)
    \/ \E w \in Stations : Release(w)
    \/ \E w \in Stations : StaleSwap(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BoundedStock ==
    \A d \in Drugs :
        /\ dispensed[d] <= Stock
        /\ remaining[d] >= 0
        /\ dispensed[d] + remaining[d] = Stock

================================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Stations = {w1, w2}
    Drugs = {d1, d2}
    Stock = 2
    MaxQueue = 3
INVARIANT BoundedStock

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od14m6p1t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Drones, MaxVer, MaxClock, LeaseLen

NONE == "none"
NoSnap == 99

VARIABLES clock, ver, lease, snap, chain
vars == <<clock, ver, lease, snap, chain>>

LeaseValid(dr) == lease.owner = dr /\ lease.exp > clock

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ lease = [owner |-> NONE, exp |-> 0]
    /\ snap = [dr \in Drones |-> NoSnap]
    /\ chain = << >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, lease, snap, chain>>

AcquireLease(dr) ==
    /\ lease.exp <= clock
    /\ lease' = [owner |-> dr, exp |-> clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, ver, snap, chain>>

Snapshot(dr) ==
    /\ LeaseValid(dr)
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![dr] = ver]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, ver, lease, chain>>

Commit(dr) ==
    /\ LeaseValid(dr)
    /\ snap[dr] = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ chain' = Append(chain, ver)
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![dr] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease>>

AdminForce ==
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ chain' = Append(chain, ver)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E dr \in Drones : AcquireLease(dr)
    \/ \E dr \in Drones : Snapshot(dr)
    \/ \E dr \in Drones : Commit(dr)
    \/ AdminForce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    /\ Len(chain) = ver
    /\ \A i \in 1 .. Len(chain) : chain[i] = i - 1

================================================================================

    MaxClock = 3

INVARIANT NoLostUpdate

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od2m0p0t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Robots, MaxVer

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, ver, inCS, read, attempts
vars == <<owner, ver, inCS, read, attempts>>

Init ==
    /\ owner = NONE
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ inCS = [r \in Robots |-> FALSE]
    /\ read = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
    /\ attempts = {}

Read(r) ==
    /\ ~inCS[r]
    /\ read' = [read EXCEPT ![r] = ver]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, inCS, attempts>>

Try(r) ==
    /\ ~inCS[r]
    /\ attempts' = attempts \cup {[by |-> r, exp |-> read[r]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, inCS, read>>

ApplyOk(m) ==
    /\ m \in attempts
    /\ owner = NONE
    /\ ver = m.exp
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ owner' = m.by
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![m.by] = TRUE]
    /\ attempts' = attempts \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED read

ApplyFail(m) ==
    /\ m \in attempts
    /\ (owner # NONE \/ ver # m.exp)
    /\ attempts' = attempts \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, inCS, read>>

Release(r) ==
    /\ inCS[r]
    /\ owner = r
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ owner' = NONE
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<read, attempts>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Read(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Try(r)
    \/ \E m \in attempts : ApplyOk(m)
    \/ \E m \in attempts : ApplyFail(m)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Release(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutexConsistent ==
    \A r \in Robots : inCS[r] <=> (owner = r)

================================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2}
    MaxVer = 4
INVARIANT MutexConsistent

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od13m3p1t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Machines, MaxTerm, MaxVer

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES leader, term, up, ver, chain
vars == <<leader, term, up, ver, chain>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term = 0
    /\ up = [m \in Machines |-> TRUE]
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ chain = << >>

Elect(m) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ up[m]
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = m
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, ver, chain>>

FailOver(m) ==
    /\ leader = m
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, ver, chain>>

Recover(m) ==
    /\ ~up[m]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, ver, chain>>

Apply(m) ==
    /\ leader = m
    /\ up[m]
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ chain' = Append(chain, ver)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, up>>

AdminForce ==
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ chain' = Append(chain, ver)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, up>>

Idle ==
    /\ ver = MaxVer
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Idle
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Elect(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : FailOver(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Recover(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Apply(m)
    \/ AdminForce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ContiguousChain ==
    /\ (chain # << >> => chain[1] = 0)
    /\ \A i \in 1 .. Len(chain) - 1 : chain[i + 1] = chain[i] + 1
    /\ Len(chain) = ver

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m6p1t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Patrons, Books, MaxVer, MaxClock, LeaseLen

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES clock, bookVer, lease, inflight, chain
vars == <<clock, bookVer, lease, inflight, chain>>

LeaseValid(p, b) == lease[b].owner = p /\ lease[b].exp > clock

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ bookVer = [b \in Books |-> 0]
    /\ lease = [b \in Books |-> [owner |-> NONE, exp |-> 0]]
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ chain = [b \in Books |-> << >>]

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bookVer, lease, inflight, chain>>

AcquireLease(p, b) ==
    /\ lease[b].exp <= clock
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![b] = [owner |-> p, exp |-> clock + LeaseLen]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, bookVer, inflight, chain>>

Submit(p, b) ==
    /\ LeaseValid(p, b)
    /\ bookVer[b] < MaxVer
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {[book |-> b, base |-> bookVer[b], by |-> p]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, bookVer, lease, chain>>

ApplyValid(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ bookVer[m.book] = m.base
    /\ bookVer[m.book] < MaxVer
    /\ bookVer' = [bookVer EXCEPT ![m.book] = bookVer[m.book] + 1]
    /\ chain' = [chain EXCEPT ![m.book] = Append(chain[m.book], m.base)]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease>>

ApplyStale(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ bookVer[m.book] # m.base
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, bookVer, lease, chain>>

Idle ==
    /\ clock = MaxClock
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Idle
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, b \in Books : AcquireLease(p, b)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, b \in Books : Submit(p, b)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : ApplyValid(m)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : ApplyStale(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    \A b \in Books :
        /\ Len(chain[b]) = bookVer[b]
        /\ \A i \in 1 .. Len(chain[b]) : chain[b][i] = i - 1

================================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Patrons = {p1, p2}
    Books = {bk1, bk2}
    MaxVer = 2
    MaxClock = 2
    LeaseLen = 2
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od18m5p2t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Total, Quorum

VARIABLES available, reserved, consumed, proposing, votes
vars == <<available, reserved, consumed, proposing, votes>>

Init ==
    /\ available = Total
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ consumed = 0
    /\ proposing = FALSE
    /\ votes = {}

Propose ==
    /\ ~proposing
    /\ available > 0
    /\ available' = available - 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ proposing' = TRUE
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED consumed

Vote(n) ==
    /\ proposing
    /\ n \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, reserved, consumed, proposing>>

Commit ==
    /\ proposing
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ consumed' = consumed + 1
    /\ proposing' = FALSE
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED available

Abort ==
    /\ proposing
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ available' = available + 1
    /\ proposing' = FALSE
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED consumed

AdminForce ==
    /\ proposing
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ consumed' = consumed + 1
    /\ proposing' = FALSE
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED available

Idle ==
    /\ ~proposing
    /\ available = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Propose
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Vote(n)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ AdminForce
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TokenConservation ==
    /\ available >= 0
    /\ reserved >= 0
    /\ consumed >= 0
    /\ available + reserved + consumed = Total

================================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
    Total = 3
    Quorum = 2
INVARIANT TokenConservation

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od7m8p4t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cranes, Blocks, MaxCap

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES coarse, fine, occ, cap
vars == <<coarse, fine, occ, cap>>

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [b \in Blocks |-> NONE]
    /\ fine = [b \in Blocks |-> NONE]
    /\ occ = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ cap = [b \in Blocks |-> 1]

AcquireCoarse(cr, b) ==
    /\ coarse[b] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![b] = cr]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, occ, cap>>

AcquireFine(cr, b) ==
    /\ coarse[b] = cr
    /\ fine[b] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![b] = cr]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, occ, cap>>

Place(cr, b) ==
    /\ coarse[b] = cr
    /\ fine[b] = cr
    /\ occ[b] < cap[b]
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = occ[b] + 1]
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, cap>>

Remove(cr, b) ==
    /\ coarse[b] = cr
    /\ occ[b] > 0
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = occ[b] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, cap>>

ReleaseCoarse(cr, b) ==
    /\ coarse[b] = cr
    /\ fine[b] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, occ, cap>>

RaiseCap(b) ==
    /\ cap[b] < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![b] = cap[b] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, occ>>

LowerCap(b) ==
    /\ cap[b] > occ[b]
    /\ cap[b] > 0
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![b] = cap[b] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, occ>>

Next ==
    \/ \E cr \in Cranes, b \in Blocks : AcquireCoarse(cr, b)
    \/ \E cr \in Cranes, b \in Blocks : AcquireFine(cr, b)
    \/ \E cr \in Cranes, b \in Blocks : Place(cr, b)
    \/ \E cr \in Cranes, b \in Blocks : Remove(cr, b)
    \/ \E cr \in Cranes, b \in Blocks : ReleaseCoarse(cr, b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : RaiseCap(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : LowerCap(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

WithinCapacity ==
    \A b \in Blocks : occ[b] <= cap[b]

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od12m9p3t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Units, Slots, MaxEpoch

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES slotOf, unitAt, inService, epoch
vars == <<slotOf, unitAt, inService, epoch>>

Init ==
    /\ slotOf = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ unitAt = [u \in Units |-> NONE]
    /\ inService = Slots
    /\ epoch = 0

Assign(u, s) ==
    /\ s \in inService
    /\ slotOf[s] = NONE
    /\ unitAt[u] = NONE
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![s] = u]
    /\ unitAt' = [unitAt EXCEPT ![u] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inService, epoch>>

Withdraw(s) ==
    /\ slotOf[s] # NONE
    /\ unitAt' = [unitAt EXCEPT ![slotOf[s]] = NONE]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inService, epoch>>

TurnOff(s) ==
    /\ s \in inService
    /\ slotOf[s] = NONE
    /\ inService' = inService \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOf, unitAt, epoch>>

TurnOn(s) ==
    /\ s \notin inService
    /\ inService' = inService \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOf, unitAt, epoch>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ slotOf' = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ unitAt' = [u \in Units |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED inService

Next ==
    \/ \E u \in Units, s \in Slots : Assign(u, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Withdraw(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : TurnOff(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : TurnOn(s)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualInverse ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : slotOf[s] # NONE => unitAt[slotOf[s]] = s
    /\ \A u \in Units : unitAt[u] # NONE => slotOf[unitAt[u]] = u

================================================================================

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od3m3p6t0 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Machines, MaxTerm

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES leader, term, up, leaderHist, posted
vars == <<leader, term, up, leaderHist, posted>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term = 0
    /\ up = [m \in Machines |-> TRUE]
    /\ leaderHist = [t \in 1 .. MaxTerm |-> NONE]
    /\ posted = {}

Elect(m) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ up[m]
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = m
    /\ leaderHist' = [leaderHist EXCEPT ![term + 1] = m]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, posted>>

Crash(m) ==
    /\ up[m]
    /\ leader = m
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leaderHist, posted>>

Recover(m) ==
    /\ ~up[m]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, leaderHist, posted>>

Post(m) ==
    /\ leader = m
    /\ up[m]

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od10m4p4t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

vars == <<free, onblock, status, queue>>

Zone(t) == IF t = "tr3" THEN "B" ELSE "A"
RunSet == {t \in Trains : status[t] = "run"}
Used == {onblock[t] : t \in RunSet}

Init ==
    /\ free = Blocks
    /\ onblock = [t \in Trains |-> NONE]
    /\ status = [t \in Trains |-> "out"]
    /\ queue = [z \in {"A", "B"} |-> << >>]

Arrive(t) ==
    /\ status[t] = "out"
    /\ Len(queue[Zone(t)]) < MaxQ
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![t] = "queued"]
    /\ queue' = [queue EXCEPT ![Zone(t)] = Append(queue[Zone(t)], t)]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, onblock>>

Admit(t) ==
    /\ status[t] = "queued"
    /\ queue[Zone(t)] # << >>
    /\ Head(queue[Zone(t)]) = t
    /\ \E b \in free :
        /\ free' = free \ {b}
        /\ onblock' = [onblock EXCEPT ![t] = b]
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![t] = "run"]
    /\ queue' = [queue EXCEPT ![Zone(t)] = Tail(queue[Zone(t)])]

Advance(t) ==
    /\ status[t] = "run"
    /\ \E b \in free :
        /\ free' = (free \ {b}) \cup {onblock[t]}
        /\ onblock' = [onblock EXCEPT ![t] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, queue>>

Exit(t) ==
    /\ status[t] = "run"
    /\ free' = free \cup {onblock[t]}
    /\ onblock' = [onblock EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![t] = "out"]
    /\ UNCHANGED queue

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Arrive(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Admit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Advance(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Exit(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TrackCapacity ==
    /\ free \cap Used = {}
    /\ free \cup Used = Blocks
    /\ \A t1, t2 \in RunSet : (t1 # t2) => onblock[t1] # onblock[t2]
    /\ Cardinality(RunSet) <= Cardinality(Blocks)

    /\ phase = [r \in Routes |-> "idle"]

    /\ committed = {}

Propose(co, r) ==
    /\ phase[r] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "prepared"]
    /\ coord' = [coord EXCEPT ![r] = co]

    /\ votes[r] = Participants
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "committed"]
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coord, votes>>

    /\ votes[r] # Participants
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "idle"]
    /\ coord' = [coord EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]

    \/ \E r \in Routes : Abort(r)
    \/ Idle

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od17m3p3t1 ------------------------------

CONSTANTS Nodes, Bags, Chutes

vars == <<leader, up, bagChute, chuteBag, msgs>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ up = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ bagChute = [b \in Bags |-> NONE]
    /\ chuteBag = [c \in Chutes |-> NONE]
    /\ msgs = {}

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ up[n]
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, bagChute, chuteBag, msgs>>

FailOver(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bagChute, chuteBag, msgs>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~up[n]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, bagChute, chuteBag, msgs>>

Issue(n, b, c) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ up[n]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[bag |-> b, chute |-> c]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, bagChute, chuteBag>>

ApplyValid(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ chuteBag[m.chute] = NONE
    /\ bagChute[m.bag] = NONE
    /\ bagChute' = [bagChute EXCEPT ![m.bag] = m.chute]
    /\ chuteBag' = [chuteBag EXCEPT ![m.chute] = m.bag]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up>>

ApplyStale(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ (chuteBag[m.chute] # NONE \/ bagChute[m.bag] # NONE)
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, bagChute, chuteBag>>

Deliver(c) ==
    /\ chuteBag[c] # NONE
    /\ bagChute' = [bagChute EXCEPT ![chuteBag[c]] = NONE]
    /\ chuteBag' = [chuteBag EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, msgs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : FailOver(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, b \in Bags, c \in Chutes : Issue(n, b, c)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : ApplyValid(m)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : ApplyStale(m)
    \/ \E c \in Chutes : Deliver(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualInverse ==
    /\ \A c \in Chutes : chuteBag[c] # NONE => bagChute[chuteBag[c]] = c
    /\ \A b \in Bags : bagChute[b] # NONE => chuteBag[bagChute[b]] = b

    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, chain, up>>

CastVote(p) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ up[p]
    /\ p \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, ver, chain, up>>

CommitRound ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes = Participants
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ chain' = Append(chain, ver)
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED up

AbortRound ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes # Participants
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, chain, up>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ up[p]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, ver, chain>>

Recover(p) ==
    /\ ~up[p]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, ver, chain>>

Idle ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ ver = MaxVer
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ OpenRound
    \/ \E p \in Participants : CastVote(p)
    \/ CommitRound
    \/ AbortRound
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Recover(p)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ContiguousChain ==
    /\ Len(chain) = ver
    /\ \A i \in 1 .. Len(chain) : chain[i] = i - 1

================================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Participants = {p1, p2}
    MaxVer = 3
INVARIANT ContiguousChain

spec_text:
------------------------------ MODULE W4Od11m6p1t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Spoolers, Jobs, MaxClock, MaxVer, LeaseLen

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES clock, jobVer, lease, applied
vars == <<clock, jobVer, lease, applied>>

LeaseValid(sp, j) == lease[j].owner = sp /\ lease[j].exp > clock

BasesOf(j) == {a.base : a \in {x \in applied : x.job = j}}

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ jobVer = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ lease = [j \in Jobs |-> [owner |-> NONE, exp |-> 0]]
    /\ applied = {}

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<jobVer, lease, applied>>

GrantLease(sp, j) ==
    /\ lease[j].exp <= clock
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![j] = [owner |-> sp, exp |-> clock + LeaseLen]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, jobVer, applied>>

ApplyEdit(sp, j) ==
    /\ LeaseValid(sp, j)
    /\ jobVer[j] < MaxVer
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {[job |-> j, base |-> jobVer[j]]}
    /\ jobVer' = [jobVer EXCEPT ![j] = jobVer[j] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease>>

ReleaseLease(sp, j) ==
    /\ lease[j].owner = sp
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![j] = [owner |-> NONE, exp |-> 0]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, jobVer, applied>>

Idle ==
    /\ clock = MaxClock
    /\ \A j \in Jobs : jobVer[j] = MaxVer
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E sp \in Spoolers, j \in Jobs : GrantLease(sp, j)
    \/ \E sp \in Spoolers, j \in Jobs : ApplyEdit(sp, j)
    \/ \E sp \in Spoolers, j \in Jobs : ReleaseLease(sp, j)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    \A j \in Jobs : BasesOf(j) = 0 .. (jobVer[j] - 1)

================================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Spoolers = {sp1, sp2}
    Jobs = {j1, j2}
    MaxClock = 2
    MaxVer = 2
    LeaseLen = 2
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
